rtogs pa'i rim pa'i dbang du byas pas so// gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang*//'jig rten 'jig med bdag nyid dang*//sems can sems kyi spyod pa dang*//de bsdus pa dang phyir ltas dang*// 14 mi bzad pa yi rnam pa dang*//chags bcas sogs dang rgya chen dang*//chen por gyur dang tshad med dang*//rnam shes bstan du med pa dang*// 15 sems bltar med dang shes pa de//g.yo ba la sogs shes bya dang*//de las gzhan yang de dgani//de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par shes// 16 thub pas de bzhin nyid rtogs te//gzhan la bstan pa zhes bya 'di//thams cad shes pa nyid skabs kyi//shes pa'i mtshan nyid bsdus pa yin// 17 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka gzhi thams cad shes pa nyid kyi skabs kyi gzhi shes pa'i sbyor bas bsdus pa'i shes pa'i cha la mtshan nyid du brjod par bya ba gang yin pa 'di chos can/ dbye na bcu drug yod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar shes pa dang*/ 'jig rten 'jig pa med pa'i bdag nyid du shes pa dang*/ sems can gyi sems kyi spyod pa shes pa dang*/ sems de nang du bsdus pa shes pa dang*/ sems phyir bltas te g.yengs pa shes pa dang*/ sems mi zad pa'i rnam par shes pa dang*/ sems 'dod chags dang bcas pa sogs shes pa dang*/ sogs khong nas sems 'dod chags dang bral bar shes pa dang*/ sems rgya chen por shes pa dang*/ sems chen por gyur pa shes pa dang*/ sems tshad med pa shes pa dang*/ rnam shes bstan du med pa shes pa dang*/ sems bltar med pa shes pa dang*/ shes pa de g.yo ba dang la sogs pas bsdu ba dang bkram pa dang bcum pa shes pa zhes bya ba dang*/ sems g.yo ba sogs de las gzhan yang sems de dag ni de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par shes pa dang*/ thub pas de bzhin nyid rtogs pa de gdul bya gzhan la bstan par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di rnams su yod pas so// bcu drug po de yang gsum du 'du ste/

sbyor ba'i byed pa dang*/ rtogs bya'i gzhi dang*/ 'bras bu ye shes rnams su 'du bas so// gnyis pa la/ chos can dang*/ chos nyid gnyis las/ dang po la yang*/ spyi dang*/ bye brag gnyis so/ /bye brag gi dbang du byas pa la shes tshan bcu gnyis yod pa'i snga ma bcu gcig ni/ sems can spyi tsam pa'i sems kyi dbang du byas la/ phyi ma ni log pa'i lta ba lan lung du ma bstan pa rnams so// gsum pa ( 'grel pa ) ni/ 'grel pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang*/ 'jig rten 'jig pa med pa dang*/ sems can gyi sems kyi spyod pa dang*/ sems bsdus pa dang*/ sems rnam par g.yengs pa dang*/ sems mi zad pa'i rnam pa dang*/ sems 'dod chags dang bcas pa la sogs pa dang*/ sogs pa zhes bya ba'i sgras bsdus pa sems 'dod chags dang bral ba dang*/ sems rgya chen po dang*/ sems chen por gyur pa dang*/ sems tshad med pa dang*/ sems bstan du med pa dang*/ sems bltar med pa dang*/ sems g.yo ba la sogs pa dang*/ g.yo ba la sogs pa de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa can dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin nyid rtogs pa de gzhan la bstan cing btags pa zhes bya ba 'di rnams kyi shes pa'i rnam pa'i bye brag bcu drug gis/ tshul bzhin du thams cad shes pa nyid kyi sbyor ba rnams ji lta ba bzhin mtshon pas na/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad shes pa nyid kyis bsdus pa yin no// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka shes pa'i mtshan nyid gzhi thams cad shes pa nyid kyi sbyor bas bsdus pas shes pa'i rnam pa'i bye brag bcu drug po gang rung gis/ don byed nus pas dngos po mtshon pa'i tshul bzhin du/ theg chen gyi thams cad shes pa nyid kyi sbyor ba rnams ji lta ba bzhin du mtshon pa'i shes pa'i cha la mtshan nyid du brjod par bya ba'i shes rnam chos can/ dbye na bcu drug yin no ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar shes pa dang*/ 'jig rten don dam par 'jig pa med par shes pa dang*/

sems can gyi sems kyi spyod pa shes pa dang*/ sems nang du bsdus pa shes pa dang*/ sems phyir rnam par g.yengs ba shes pa dang*/ sems mi zad pa'i rnam par shes pa dang*/ sems 'dod chags dang bcas pa la sogs par shes pa dang*/ sogs pa zhes bya ba'i sgras bsdus pa sems 'dod chags dang bral bar shes pa dang*/ sems de kho nar rgya chen por shes pa dang*/ sems chen por gyur pa shes pa dang*/ sems don dam du tshad med par shes pa dang*/ sems dbang po'i yul du bstan du med par shes pa dang*/

sems don dam du spyan lngas kyang bltar med par shes pa dang*/ sems g.yo ba dang 'du ba la sogs sems 'khrul gzhi phung po lnga la brten nas 'khrul bar shes pa dang*/ g.yo ba la sogs pa don dam par de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa can du shes pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin nyid rtogs pa de gzhan la bstan cing btags pa zhes bya ba 'di rnams su yod pas so// gnyis pa lam shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan la gsum las/ dang po ( mtshams sbyar ) ni/ 'grel pa/ de'i 'og tu lam shes pa nyid kyi sgo nas/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka gzhi shes kyi shes mtshan de'i 'og tu lam shes pa nyid kyi sgo nas shes mtshan 'chad de/ de skabs su bab pas so// gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ stong nyid mtshan med bcas pa dang*//smon pa rnam par spangs pa dang*//skye med 'gag pa med sogs dang*//chos nyid rnam par 'khrug med dang*// 18 'du mi byed dang rnam mi rtog/rab dbye mtshan nyid med nyid la//lam shes nyid kyi skabs kyis ni//shes pa'i mtshan nyid yin par bzhed// 19 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka lam shes pa nyid 'chad pa'i skabs kyis bsdus pa'i shes pa'i mtshan nyid gang yin pa chos can/ dbye na bcu drug tu bzhed de/ stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i shes mtshan dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang bcas par rtogs pa dang*/ smon pa rnam par spangs pas smon med rtogs pa dang*/ skye med rtogs pa dang*/ 'gag pa med par rtogs pa dang*/ sogs khong nas kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa sogs drug dang*/ chos nyid rnam par 'khrug pa med par rtogs pa dang*/ 'du mi byed pa dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ rab tu dbye ba dang*/ mtshan nyid med pa nyid du rtogs pa'i shes rnam rnams su yod pas so// de dag bsdu na bzhir 'du ste/ lam gyi chos nyid kyi dbye ba dang*/ ma bcos pa dang*/ blo las 'das pa dang*/ bden gnyis kyi khyad par rnams su 'du bas so/ /de yang shes mtshan gyi yul chos nyid kyi dbang du byas nas rnam thar sgo gsum gyi chos nyid dang skye med 'gag med kyi chos nyid sogs khong nas kun nyon med pa'i chos nyid sogs drug ste bcu gcig

/ma bcos pa la gang zag gis ma byas pa dang*/ chos kyis ma byas pa gnyis so// gsum pa ( 'grel pa ) ni/ 'grel pa/ stong pa dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa dang*/ skye ba med pa dang*/ 'gag pa med pa/ la sogs pa zhes bya ba'i sgras bsdus pa kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang*/ rnam par byang ba med pa dang*/ dngos po med pa dang*/ ngo bo nyid dang*/ rten med pa dang*/ nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de drug dang*/ chos nyid rnam par 'khrug pa med pa dang*/ 'du mi byed pa dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ rab tu dbye ba dang*/ mtshan nyid med pa zhes bya ba 'di rnams kyi shes pa'i rnam pa'i khyad par bcu drug gis ji lta ba bzhin du/ lam shes pa nyid kyi sbyor ba dag mtshon pas na shes pa'i mtshan nyid lam shes pa nyid kyis bsdus pa yin no// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka bya dka' ba la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sbyor ba rnams ji lta ba bzhin du lam shes pa nyid kyi sbyor ba dag tu mtshon par byed pas na shes pa'i mtshan nyid lam shes pa nyid kyis bsdus pa'i shes pa'i rnam pa'i khyad par chos can/ bcu drug yod de/ rang gi ngo bos stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i ye shes dang*/ rgyu'i mtshan ma med pa dang*/ 'bras bu la smon pa med pa dang*/ sngar med skye ba med pa dang*/ sngar yod 'gag pa med pa dang*/ rtsa bar sogs pa zhes bya ba'i sgras bsdus pa chags sogs kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang*/ dad sogs rnam par byang ba med pa dang*/ spang bya'i dngos po med pa dang*/ myang 'das kyi ngo bo nyid du med pa dang*/ chos dbyings kyi rten med pa dang*/ 'gyur ba med pa nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de dngos su rtsa tshig med pa drug dang*/ chos nyid lha mi sogs kyis dkrugs pas rnam par 'khrug pa med pa dang*/ rgyu 'bras 'du mi byed pa dang*/ 'dus ma byas pas gang du yang rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ kun rdzob tu stong nyid nas rnam mi rtog gi bar rab tu dbye ba dang*/

mtshan nyid kyi rab dbye don dam du med pa zhes bya ba 'di rnams su yod pas so// gsum pa rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan la gsum las/ dang po ( mtshams sbyar ) ni/ 'grel pa/ de'i 'og tu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sgo nas/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka lam shes kyi shes mtshan bshad pa de'i 'og tu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sgo nas shes mtshan 'chad de/ de skabs su bab pas so// gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ de ni nyid kyi chos bsten nas//gnas dang gus par bya ba dang*//bla ma nyid dang mnyes pa dang*//de la mchod dang byed med dang*// 20 kun tu 'jug mkhyen gang yin dang*//ma mthong ston par mdzad pa dang*//'jig rten stong nyid rnam pa dang*//brjod dang shes mdzad mngon sum mdzad// 21 bsam mi khyab dang zhi nyid ston//'jig rten 'du shes 'gog pa la//rnam pa kun mkhyen tshul la ni//shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bshad do// 22 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka rnam pa kun mkhyen pa rnam mkhyen gyi tshul la ni shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bshad pa 'di chos can/ bcu drug yod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa de ni de nyid kyi chos rnam mkhyen la brten nas bde bar gnas pa dang*/ gus par bya ba dang*/ bla ma nyid du bya ba dang*/ mnyes par bya ba dang*/ sangs rgyas de la mchod par bya ba dang*/ don dam du byed pa po'i rgyu med pa dang*/ ye shes shes bya kun tu 'jug par mkhyen pa gang yin pa dang*/ ma mthong ba'i don de kho na nyid mthong bar ston par mdzad pa dang*/ 'jig rten stong pa nyid kyi rnam par ston pa dang*/ de stong nyid du rjod pa dang*/ de stong nyid du shes par mdzad pa dang*/ de stong nyid du mngon sum du mthong bar mdzad pa dang*/ 'jig rten bsam gyis mi khyab par ston pa dang*/ 'jig rten zhi ba nyid du ston pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi dngos po 'gog pa dang*/ mtshan 'dzin gyi 'du shes 'gog pa rnams su yod pas so//

de ltar bcu drug po de yang bsdu na gsum du 'du ste/ rang don phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ gzhan don phrin las kyi yon tan dang*/ gnyis ka'i yon tan dang gsum du 'du bas so/ /dang po la yang gsum ste/ bde bar gnas pa dang*/ gzhan gyis mchod pa dang*/ mkhyen pa'i yon tan no/ /gnyis pa la/ kun rdzob dang*/ don dam gyi dbang du byas pa gnyis/ gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas/ mkhyen pa'i yon tan la/ ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa dang*/ gzhan don phrin las dang*/ gnyis don bstan pa dang gsum/ gzhan don phrin las kyi dbang du mdzad pa la/ spyir bstan dang*/ bye brag tu bstan pa gnyis/ bye brag la mdzad pa gsum gyi yon tan dang*/ gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa bskyed thabs gnyis las/ dang po la gsum ste/ ma bsdus pa sdud pa/ bsdus pa smin pa/ smin pa grol ba'o// gsum pa ( 'grel pa ) ni/ 'grel pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa de nyid kyi chos la mngon par brten nas gnas pa dang*/ gus par bya ba dang*/ bla mar bya ba dang*/ mnyes par bya ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ byed pa med pa nyid dang*/ thams cad du 'gro ba dang*/ ma mthong ba'i don ston pa dang*/ 'jig rten stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa dang*/ 'jig rten stong pa nyid du brjod pa dang*/ 'jig rten stong pa nyid du shes par mdzad pa dang*/ 'jig rten stong pa nyid du mthong bar mdzad pa dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid du ston pa dang*/ zhi ba nyid du ston pa dang*/ 'jig rten 'gog pa dang*/ 'du shes 'gog pa zhes bya ba 'di rnams kyi shes pa'i rnam pa'i bye brag bcu drug gis ji lta ba bzhin du/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sbyor ba dag mtshon pas na/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis bsdus pa yin no// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka don byed nus pas dngos po mtshon tshul ji lta ba bzhin du/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sbyor ba dag mtshon par byed pas na shes pa'i mtshan nyid rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sbyor bas bsdus pa'i shes pa'i rnam pa'i bye brag chos can/

bcu drug yod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa de nyid kyi chos rnam mkhyen la mngon par brten nas gnas pa dang*/ gus par bya ba dang*/ bla mar bya ba dang*/ mnyes par bya ba dang*/ mchod par bya ba dang*/ don dam par byed pa po'i rgyu med pa nyid dang*/ ye shes shes bya thams cad la thogs med du 'gro ba dang*/ 'ga' yang ma mthong ba nyid de kho na'i don mthong bar ston pa dang*/ 'jig rten stong pa nyid kyi rnam par ston pa dang*/ thos bsam gyi shes rab bskyed pa'i don du 'jig rten stong pa nyid du rjod par mdzad pa dang*/ bsgoms byung bskyed pa'i don du 'jig rten stong pa nyid du shes par mdzad pa dang*/ 'das pa'i rtogs pa bskyed pa'i don du 'jig rten stong pa nyid du mthong bar mdzad pa dang*/ 'jig rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid du ston pa dang*/ 'jig rten zhi ba nyid du ston pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi dngos po 'gog pa dang*/ mtshan 'dzin gyi 'du shes 'gog pa zhes bya ba 'di rnams su yod pas so// gnyis pa khyad par gyi mtshan nyid la gsum/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ de ltar bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa dgus shes pa'i mtshan nyid spyi'i ngo bo nyid du brjod nas/ shes pa'i rnam pas yongs su bcad pa rnams kyi khyad par shes par bya ba yin pas shes pa'i mtshan nyid kyi 'og tu/ bar skabs kyi tshiḍa su bcad pas khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka bshad zin pa de ltar bar tshigs dgus shes pa'i mtshan nyid theg pa che chung so sor ma bcad par spyi'i ngo bo nyid du brjod nas shes pa'i mtshan nyid de'i 'og tu bar tshigs bzhis khyad par gyi mtshan nyid gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ shes pa'i rnam pas sbyor ba gsum du yongs su bcad pa rnams kyi khyad par shes par bya ba'i ched yin pas so// gnyis pa ( bstan ) la/ rtsa ba/ 'grel pa gnyis las/ dang po (

rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyis// khyad zhugs bden pa'i spyod yul can//skad cig ma ni bcu drug gis//khyad par mtshan nyid bshad pa yin// 23 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka bden pa bzhi'i spyod yul can theg chen gyi mthong lam shes bzod skad cig ma ni bcu drug chos can/ theg chen gyi mthong lam theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags pa'i mtshan nyid can du bshad pa yin te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam de bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ mi mnyam pa sogs khyad par gyi chos bcu drug gi sgo nas theg dman gyi sbyor ba bas khyad zhugs par bshad pas so// gnyis pa ( 'grel pa ) ni/ 'grel pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ mi mnyam pa la sogs pa'i khyad par gyi khyad par du byas pa'i sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa'i yul can chos dang*/ rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid bcu drug gis lam shes pa nyid la sogs pa'i sbyor ba dag mtshon pas na/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid yin no// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa bzhi'i yul can chos bzod bzhi dang rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa bzhi dang*/ chos shes rjes shes bzhi bzhi'i mtshan nyid can theg chen gyi mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug chos can/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid yin no ste/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang mi mnyam pa la sogs pa'i khyad par bcu drug gis lam shes pa nyid dang la sogs pas rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba dag theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad par du byas pa'i sbyor ba yin par mtshon pas na'o// gzhi shes la khyad mtshan mi 'chad pa'i don ni/ shes mtshan gyis mi ldan rnam gcod kyis mtshon la khyad mtshan gyis gzhan ldan rnam gcod kyis mtshon pas gzhan la ldan pa gcad dgos pa'i phyir/ gzhi shes la khyad mtshan ma bshad do/ /'on kyang 'phags grol gyis sbyor ba gsum car la sbyar bas lugs de legs pa yin te/

theg chen gyi sbyor ba gcig gi ngo bo yin pas so/ /mthong lam gyi khyad par bshad pas de'i rgyu sbyor lam dang 'bras bu sgom lam gyi khyad par yang bshad par 'gyur ro// gsum pa la gsum las/ dang po ( mtshams sbyar ) ni/ 'grel pa/ yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa'i khyad par gang yin zhe na/ bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa gsum po// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka mdor bstan gyi 'og tu bar tshigs gsum pos yang khyad par bcu drug rgyas par bshad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ gong du smos pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang la sogs pas mi mnyam pa sogs kyi khyad par bcu drug po de gang yin zhe na/ de'i lan bstan pa'i ched yod pas so// gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ bsam mi khyab dang mi mnyam dang*//gzhal dang bgrang las yang dag 'das//'phags pa kun bsdus mkhas pa yis//rig bya thun mong min shes nyid// 24 shes myur bri dang gang med dang*//sgrub dang yang dag 'grub pa dang*//dmigs pa brten dang bcas pa dang*//mtha' dag pa dang yongs 'dzin dang*// 25 ro myang med dang khyad par ni//bcu drug bdag nyid ces bya ste//gang gis lam ni gzhan dag las//khyad du 'phags pas khyad par lam// 26 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka bden pa bzhi'i yul can bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug las/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i yul can bzhi ni/ bsam mi khyab dang*/ mi mnyam pa dang*/gzhal ba las yang dag par 'das pa dang*/ bgrang ba las yang dag par 'das pa'o// kun 'byung bden pa'i yul can bzhi ni/ 'phags pa'i gang zag gi yon tan kun sdud pa dang*/ skyes bu mkhas pa yis rig par bya ba'i zab mo rtogs pa dang*/ nyan rang dang thun mong ma yin pa'i don shes pa nyid dang*/ mngon par shes pa nyan rang las shin tu myur ba nyid do// 'gog bden gyi yul can bzhi ni/ chos thams cad bri ba med par rtogs pa dang*/ gang ba med par rtogs pa dang*/ phyin drug brtson 'grus kyis sgrub pas tshogs gnyis yang dag par 'grub pa dang*/

chos thams cad la mi rtog par dmigs pa rnams so// lam bden gyi yul can bzhi ni/ rten chos dbyings kyi rigs dang bcas pa dang*/ smon lam la sogs pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pa'i rgyu tshogs mtha' dag dang ldan pa dang*/ theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ yul la ro myang ba'i mngon zhen med pa ste/ de lta bu'i khyad par gyi chos ni bcu drug gi bdag nyid 'dis shes par bya ste/ khyad chos gang gis theg chen gyi mthong lam ni/ gzhan dman lam dag las khyad par du 'phags pas khyad par gyi lam yin no zhes don bsdus so// gsum pa ( 'grel pa ) la/ rtsa ba'i tshig don dang*/ dman lam mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la sogs pas legs par yongs su bzung ba'i shes rab kyi stobs kyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid dang*/ mi nyams pa nyid dang*/ gzhal ba las yang dag par 'das pa dang*/ bgrang ba las yang dag par 'das pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad sdud pa dang*/ skyes bu mkhas pas rig par bya ba nyid dang*/ nyan thos la sogs pa'i spyod yul ma yin pa'i dngos po yongs su shes pa dang*/ rang gi lugs las ltos pa'i mngon par shes pa shin tu myur ba'i shes pa dang*/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa la brten pa'i chos thams cad dri ba med pa dang gang ba med pa'i ngo bo dang*/ 'khor gsum rnam par dag pas sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug rab tu sgrub pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i sbyor bas bskal pa du mar bsgrub pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes yang dag par 'grub pa dang*/ rnam par mi rtog par chos thams cad la dmigs pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid byang chub sems dpa'i rten dang*/ smon lam la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyu'i tshogs pa dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi thabs kyis yongs su bzung ba dang*/

mngon par zhen pa'i ro myang ba med pa dang bcu drug gi bdag nyid ces bya ba ni/ go rim bzhin du sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa'i skad cig ma rnams kyi khyad par yin te/ gang gis nyan thos la sogs pa'i lam rnams las byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa'i lam shes pa nyid la sogs pa gnyis ni/ khyad par gyi lam yin par khyad zhugs so// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka byang chub sems dpa'i lam shes pa nyid kyi sbyor ba dang la sogs pas sangs rgyas kyi rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba gnyis ni chos can/ khyad par gyi lam yin te/ khyad chos bcu drug po gang rung gi sgo nas nyan thos la sogs pa theg dman gyi lam rnams las khyad zhugs pas so// bcu drug po de yang yul gyi dbang gis ris bsdu na yul bden pa bzhi po re re la yul can bzhi bzhi yod pas/ yul yul can go rim bzhin du sbyar na/ sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa bzhi'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i theg chen sbyor ba skad cig ma bcu drug yod pa rnams kyi nang nas sdug bden gyi yul can gyi theg chen sbyor ba chos can/ skad cig ma bzhi yod de/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang la sogs pas byang sems snga ma rnams kyis legs par yongs su gzung ba'i shes rab kyi stobs kyis rtog ge'i blos bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid dang*/ zla med pas mi mnyam pa nyid dang*/ tshad mas gzhal ba las yang dag par 'das pa dang*/ grangs kyis bgrang ba las yang dag par 'das pa'i sdug bden gyi chos nyid rtogs pa'i sbyor ba bzhi yod pas so// kun 'byung bden pa'i yul can gyi theg chen sbyor ba chos can/

bsal ba sngar bzhin/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi yon tan sdud pa dang*/ ji lta ji snyed la mkhas pa'i skyes bus rig par bya ba'i gnas lugs rtogs pa nyid dang*/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal la sogs pa'i spyod yul ma yin pa'i dngos po phra mo de kho na nyid yongs su shes pa dang*/ theg chen rang gi lugs las ltos pa'i mngon par shes pa nyan rang las shin tu myur ba'i shes pa rnams su yod pas so// 'gog bden gyi sogs chos can/ sngar bzhin/ kun rdzob bden pa la brten nas skur ba mi 'debs pas chos thams cad bri ba med pa dang*/ don dam pa'i bden pa la brten nas sgro mi 'dogs pas gang ba med pa'i ngo bo rtogs pa dang*/ 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa brtson 'grus kyis drag tu rab tu sgrub pa dang yang dag pa'i sbyor ba gus rtag gnyis kyi sgo nas bskal pa du mar bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par 'grub pa dang*/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad la rnam par mi rtog par dmigs pa rnams su yod pas so// lam bden gyi sogs chos can/ sngar bzhin/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi rten chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid kyi rigs dang ldan pa dang*/ smon lam la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bcu yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyu tshogs pa dang ldan pa dang*/ theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi thabs mkhas kyis yongs su gzung ba dang*/ gzugs sogs la mngon par zhen pa'i ro myang ba med pa rnams su yod pas so// gnyis pa ( dman lam mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ) ni/ 'grel pa/ de'i phyir de dag gi ni ji skad bshad pa'i khyad par dang bral ba'i mngon par zhen pa la sogs pa skye ba'i mtshan nyid kyis go sla ba'i phyir ma bshad do// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka nyan rang de dag gi lam ni chos can/ go sla ba'i phyir na skabs 'dir dngos su ma bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/

ji skad bshad pa'i khyad par bcu drug po rnams dang bral ba'i mngon par zhen pa la sogs pa skye ba'i mtshan nyid can du sngar las bzlog pa nyid kyis rtogs pa'i phyir te/ byang sems kyi sbyor ba khyad par bcu drug dang ldan par dngos su bstan pa de'i phyir ro// gsum pa byed pa'i mtshan nyid la gsum las/ dang po ( mtshams sbyar ) ni/ 'grel pa/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid kyis rnam par bcad pa rnams kyi byed pa gang yin zhe na/ bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka khyad mtshan gyi rjes su phan dang sogs bar tshigs gnyis kyis byed pa'i mtshan nyid bshad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid kyis mi ldan pa dang gzhan ldan rnam par bcad pa'i theg chen gyi sgrub pa rnams kyi byed pa phrin las gang yin zhe na/ de'i lan bstan pa'i ched yod pas so// gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ phan dang bde dang skyob pa dang*//mi rnams kyi ni skyabs dag dang*//gnas dang dpung gnyen gling dang ni//yongs 'dren pa zhes bya ba dang*// 27 lhun gyis grub dang theg gsum gyis//'bras bu mngon sum mi byed dag/tha ma rten gyi mdzad pa ste//'di ni byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin// 28 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka theg chen sbyor ba'i byed pa'i mtshan nyid gang yin pa 'di ni chos can/ dbye na bcu gcig yod de/ gdul bya la phan par byed pa dang*/ bde bar byed pa dang*/ skyob par byed pa dang*/ mi rnams kyi ni skyabs dag byed pa dang*/ gnas su byed pa dang*/ dpung gnyen byed pa dang*/ gling gi byed pa dang ni/ yongs su 'dren par byed pa zhes bya ba dang*/ lhun gyis grub pa'i byed pa dang*/ rdzogs smin ma sbyangs par theg pa gsum gyi 'bras bu mngon sum du mi byed pa'i bdag nyid du byed pa dang*/ bcu gcig po'i tha ma rten gyi mdzad pa ste de rnams su yod pas so//

byed pa bcu gcig po de yang bsdu na gsum du 'du ste/ mkhyen pa gsum gyi sbyor ba'i byed pa gsum du 'du bas so/ /de yang gzhi shes sbyor ba'i byed pa'i dbang du byas nas dang po gsum dang*/ lam shes sbyor ba'i byed pa'i dbang du byas nas skyabs la sogs pa bdun dang*/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i byed pa'i dbang du byas nas rten gyi byed pa gsungs so// gsum pa ( 'grel pa ) la/ tshig gi don dang*/ mtshon tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ ma 'ongs pa'i phan pa dang*/ tshe 'di'i bde ba dang*/ sdug bsngal med pa'i rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i chos nyid nye bar bsgrub pa'i don gyis thams cad shes pa nyid kyi phan pa la sogs pa'i byed pa gsum mo// gtan du phan pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu bzlog pa dang*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa mnyam pa nyid du+u rtogs pa dang*/ rang dang gzhan gyi don rtogs pa'i rten gyi ngo bo dang*/ gzhan gyi don sgrub pa dang*/ sems can gyi don lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi nges par 'byung ba'i 'bras bu mngon sum du mi byed pa zhes bya ba 'di rnams dus ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag par nye bar sgrub pa'i don gyis lam shes pa nyid kyi skyabs la sogs pa'i byed pa bdun no// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos thams cad ston pa nye bar sgrub pa'i don gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la ni rten gyi mdzad pa gcig ste/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka gdul bya myang 'das la 'god pa ma 'ongs pa'i phan pa dang*/ yid mi bde las 'grol ba tshe 'di'i bde ba dang*/ yang srid mi len pas sdug bsngal med pa'i rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i chos nyid sgrub par mdzad pa ste phan pa la sogs pa'i byed pa gsum chos can/ gzhi thams cad shes pa nyid kyi sbyor ba'i byed pa yin te/ gzhi shes sbyor bas gdul bya la phan pa nye bar sgrub par byed pa'i mdzad pa yin pa'i don gyis so/

/gtan du phan pa skyabs kyi byed pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu bden 'dzin zlog pa gnas kyi byed pa dang*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa bden med mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa dpung gnyen gyi dang*/ 'khor 'das la blang dor med pa rang dang gzhan gyi don rtogs pa'i rten gyi ngo bo gling gi dang*/ rang don la mi sred pa'i thabs su gzhan gyi don sgrub pa yongs 'dren gyi dang*/ sems can gyi don la 'bad med lhun gyis grub par 'jug par mdzad pa lhun grub kyi dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi lam gyis rang rang gi spang bya las nges par 'byung yang rdzogs smin ma sbyangs par 'bras bu mngon sum du mi byed pa zhes bya ba skyabs la sogs pa'i byed pa bdun rnams chos can/ lam shes pa nyid kyi sbyor ba'i byed pa yin te/ lam shes kyi gdul bya la ji lta ba bzhin du phan pa yang dag par nye bar sgrub pa'i don gyis so/ /byed pa bcu gcig pa tha ma rten gyi mdzad pa gcig chos can/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sbyor ba'i byed pa yin te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sbyor bas gdul bya rnam mkhyen gyi dbang du byas pa'i chos thams cad ston pa nye bar sgrub pa'i mdzad pa yin pa'i don gyis so// gnyis pa ( mtshon tshul ) ni/ 'grel pa/ de ltar na byed pa'i rnam pa dag gis ji lta ba bzhin du/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi sbyor ba dag mtshon pas na byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin no// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka bshad ma thag pa'i bcu+u gcig po 'di chos can/ mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba'i byed pa mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid yin te/ bshad pa de ltar byed pa'i rnam pa bcu gcig po dag gis thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi sbyor ba dag don byed nus pas dngos po mtshon pa ji lta ba bzhin du mtshon par byed pas na'o// bzhi pa ngo bo nyid mtshan la gsum las/ dang po ( mtshams sbyar ) ni/ 'grel pa/ byed pa'i mtshan nyid kyis shes par byas pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid gang yin zhe na/

bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa gsum gyis ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka byed mtshan bshad pa'i 'og tu bar tshigs gsum gyis ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ byed pa'i mtshan nyid kyis shes par byas pa'i sbyor ba rnams kyi ngo bo nyid gang yin zhe na/ de'i lan bstan pa'i ched yod pas so// gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ nyon mongs rtags dang mtshan ma dang*//mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po dag /dben dang dka' dang nges pa dang*//ched du bya dang mi dmigs dang*// 29 mngon par zhen pa bkag pa dang*//dmigs pa zhes bya gang yin dang*//mi mthun thogs pa med dang de//gzhi med 'gro med skye med dang*// 30 de bzhin nyid ni mi dmigs dang*//ngo bo nyid bcu drug bdag nyid//mtshon bya lta bur mtshon pas na//mtshan nyid bzhi par bzhed pa yin// 31 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka mtshon bya lta bur mtshon pas na mtshan nyid bzhi pa ngo bo nyid mtshan du bzhed pa'i mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba chos can/ dbye na ngo bo nyid mtshan bcu drug gi bdag nyid yin te/ nyon mongs kyi ngo bos dben pa dang*/ de'i 'bras bu rtags kyis dang*/ de'i rgyu mtshan mas dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang gnyen po dag gis stong pa ste shes sgrib kyis dben pa dang*/ bya dka' ba'i ngo bo nyid dang*/ mtha' gcig tu nges pa'i dang*/ ched du bya ba ma 'khrul ba'i dang*/ bsgom bya sgom pa po'i chos mi dmigs pa'i dang*/ mngon par zhen pa bkag pa'i dang*/ chos can rnam pa ma lus pa la dmigs pa zhes bya ba gang yin pa'i dang*/ 'jig rten dang mi mthun pa'i dang*/ yul la thogs pa med par 'jug pa'i dang*/ don dam par gzhi med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ chos nyid dman pa las mchog tu 'gro ba med par rtogs pa'i dang*/ lam gyi rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i dang*/ gzhi'i de bzhin nyid ni mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i ngo bo nyid rnams su yod pas so//

gsum pa ( 'grel pa ) la/ dbye ba dang*/ mtshon tshul gnyis las/ dang po la gsum/ gzhi shes sbyor ba'i/ lam shes sbyor ba'i/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ de'i rtags lus kyi gnas ngan len dang*/ de'i mtshan ma tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa la sogs pa dang*/ 'dod chags dang 'dod chags med pa la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang gnyen po dag stong pa nyid kyis thams cad shes pa nyid kyi dben pa'i ngo bo nyid bzhi'o// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka byang sems kyi rgyud kyi gzhi thams cad shes pa nyid kyi sbyor ba chos can/ dbye na bzhi yod de/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis dben pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ nyon mongs de'i rtags lus ngag gi gnas ngan len gyis dben pa'i ngo bo nyid dang*/ nyon mongs de'i mtshan ma tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa la sogs pas dben pa'i ngo bo nyid de nyon mongs kyi gnyen po'i dbang du byas pa gsum dang*/ 'dod chags dang 'dod chags med pa la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang gnyen po rtogs pa dag gis stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid gcig rnams su yod pas so// gnyis pa ( lam shes sbyor ba'i ) ni/ 'grel pa/ don dam par med pa'i sems can mya ngan las 'da' bar dka' ba dang*/ theg pa gzhan du mi ltung ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mtha' gcig tu nges pa dang*/ yun ring po nas bsgrub par bya ba mchog nyid kyi ched du bya ba dang*/ bsgom par bya ba dang sgom pa po'i chos mi dmigs pa dang*/ dngos por mngon par zhen pa mtha' dag bkag pa zhes bya ba de lta bu dag ni/ lam shes pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid lnga'o// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka lam shes pa nyid kyi sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid chos can/ dbye na lnga'o ste/ don dam par med pa'i sems can rnams mya ngan las 'da' bar byed pa'i go bgos pas bya dka' ba'i byed pa dang*/

theg pa gzhan theg dman du mi ltung ba'i mtshan nyid can yin pas rnam mkhyen du mtha' gcig tu nges pa dang*/ yun ring po bskal pa du ma nas bsgrub par bya ba'i mchog chen po gsum gyi don du 'bad pa nyid kyi ched du bya ba ma 'khrul ba dang*/ bsgom par bya ba dang sgom pa po'i chos mi dmigs pas zab mo rtogs pa dang*/ dngos por mngon par zhen pa mtha' dag bkag pa'i bdag nyid yin pas rnam byang la zhen pa med pa'i ngo bo nyid rnams su yod pas so/ /zhes bya ba de lta bu dag na zhes pa mtshan gzhi dang sbyor ba'i tshig go/ gsum pa ( rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid mtshan ) ni/ 'grel pa/ thams cad shes pa nyid dang lam shes pa nyid kyis bsdus pa'i dngos po'i khyad par la dmigs pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi sgrub pa'i 'dzin pa la sogs pa las bzlog ste bstan pas mi mthun pa dang*/ gzugs la sogs pa thogs pa med par shes pa dang*/ shes bya dang shes pa mi dmigs pas gzhi med pa dang*/ de bzhin nyid kyis 'gro ba med pa dang*/ gzugs la sogs pa ngo bo nyid med pas skye ba med pa dang*/dngos po dang dngos po med pa la sogs pa gsum gyi ngo bo de bzhin nyid mi dmigs pa zhes bya ba de lta bu dag ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid bdun no// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid chos can/ dbye na bdun no ste/ thams cad shes pa nyid dang lam shes pa nyid kyis bsdus pa'i dngos po'i khyad par la dmigs pas rnam pa ma lus pa la dmigs pa'i ngo bo nyid dang*/ 'jig rten gyi sgrub pa'i 'dzin pa las bzlog ste gzung 'dzin gnyis med du sgom par bstan pas 'jig rten thams cad dang mi mthun pa dang*/ gzugs la sogs pa thogs pa med par shes pas yul la thogs med du 'jug pa dang*/ shes bya dang shes pa mi dmigs par rtogs pas don dam par gzhi med par rtogs pa dang*/

de bzhin nyid rtogs pa nyid kyis chos nyid dman pa las mchog tu 'gro ba med par rtogs pa dang*/ gzugs la sogs pa ngo bo nyid med par rtogs pas lam gyi rnam pa skye ba med par rtogs pa dang*/ dngos po dang dngos po med pa dang la sogs pas gnyis ka ma yin pa dang gsum gyi ngo bo mi dmigs par rtogs pas gzhi'i de bzhin nyid mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i ngo bo nyid rnams su yod pas so/ /zhes bya ba de lta bu dag ni zhes pa sngar bzhin no// gnyis pa mtshon tshul ni/ 'grel pa/ de ltar na ngo bo nyid bcu drug gis ji lta ba bzhin du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi sbyor ba dag mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bzhin du mtshon pas de ltar na bzhi pa ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid du bzhed do// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi sbyor ba'i bdag nyid dag gong du bstan pa de ltar na ngo bo nyid bcu drug gis chos can/ bzhi pa ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid du bzhed do ste/ ji lta ba bzhin du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bzhin du mtshon par bya ba yin pas de ltar na'o/ /de ltar na mtshon byed yin pas byed sgrub tu thal bar 'gyur ba ma yin nam zhe na mtshan nyid dang ldan pa nyid du mtshon par byed mod kyi 'on kyang mtshon par bya ba'i gzhi'i ngo bo nyid yin pas na las sgrub tu bzhag pa la nyes pa med do// bzhi pa grangs bsdu ba ni/ 'grel pa/ de ltar na spyir gcig tu bsdoms na ni mtshan nyid dgu bcu rtsa gcig tu 'gyur ro// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka spyir gcig tu bsdoms na mtshan nyid dgu bcu rtsa gcig tu 'gyur ro ste/ shes mtshan zhe brgyad khyad mtshan bcu drug byed mtshan bcu gcig ngo bo nyid mtshan bcu drug yod pa de ltar na'o// bzhi pa thar pa cha mthun la gsum/ sbyar/ bstan/ bshad do/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan pa kho na la ji skad bshad pa'i sbyor ba yongs su shes pa 'byung bas/

thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka mtshan nyid kyi 'og tu thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa 'chad de/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan pa kho na la gong du ji skad bshad pa'i sbyor ba yongs su shes pa 'byung bas so// gnyis pa

( bstan ) la/ rtsa ba/ 'grel pa gnyis las/ dang po ( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs//yang dag sgrub la mkhas pa ni//rnam pa thams cad rtogs 'di la//thar pa'i cha dang mthun par 'dod// 32 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka mtshan ma med pa'i gnas lugs rtogs shing rab tu sbyin pa gtong ba la sogs pa rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi yon tan rnams 'byung la yang dag par sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i byang sems las dang po pa'i mngon rtogs ni chos can/ rnam pa thams cad mngon par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba 'chad pa'i skabs 'di la bstan pa'i thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa yin par 'dod de/ thabs shes zung 'brel gyi chos mngon rtogs yin pas so// ngag don/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi ye shes chos can/ theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun yin te/ sbyin sogs rang rgyud la bskyed par mkhas pa'i theg chen las dang po pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ( 'grel pa ) ni/ 'grel pa/ mtshan ma med par dmigs pa'i shes pa'i rnam pas/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la thug pa rnams rang gi rgyud la skyed par mkhas pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa 'di la thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa yin par 'dod do// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis chos thams cad la mtshan ma med par dmigs pa'i shes pa'i rnam pas sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la thug pa'i bar rnams rang gi rgyud la sa bon nus ldan du bzhag pa'i sgo nas bskyed par mkhas pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa'i mngon rtogs ni chos can/ rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzoḍa par rtoḍa pa'i sbyor ba 'chad pa'i skabs 'di la bstan pa'i thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa yin par 'dod do ste/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i theg chen las dang po pa'i mkhyen pa yin pas so//

gsum pa ( bshad ) la gsum las/ dang po ( mtshams sbyar ) ni/ 'grel pa/ mkhas pa de gang yin zhe na/ de bstan pa'i phyir bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka mdor bstan gyi rjes su bar tshigs gnyis kyis rgyas par bshad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ mdor bstan du sgrub la mkhas pa ni zhes gsungs pa'i mkhas pa de gang yin zhe na/ de'i lan bstan pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) la/ yul gyi dbye ba dang*/ dbang po'i dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rtsa ba/ sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa dang*//sbyin sogs spyod yul brtson 'grus dang*//bsam pa phun tshogs dran pa dang*//rnam par mi rtog ting 'dzin dang*// 33 chos rnams rnam pa thams cad du//shes pa'i shes rab dang rnam lnga// rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka byang sems tshogs lam pas mkhas par bya ba chos can/ rnam pa lnga yod de/ yul sangs rgyas sogs la dmigs pa'i dad pa dang*/ sbyin sogs la spyod pa'i yul la brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam pa phun tshogs sems bskyed sogs dran pa dang*/ 'khor gsum du rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ gzugs sogs chos rnams kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid rnam pa thams cad du shes pa'i shes rab rnams su yod pas so// gnyis pa ( dbang po'i dbye ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnon po yis//rtogs sla rtul pos rtogs dkar bzhed// 34 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka bshad ma thag pa'i dad sogs de dag thams cad kyis bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur du rtogs par mtshungs pa ma yin te/ dad sogs de dag chen po dbang po rnon po yis bla med byang chub rtogs par sla la dad sogs chung ngu dbang po rtul pos bla med byang chub rtogs dka' bar bzhed pas so// gsum pa ( 'grel pa ) la yang*/ rtsa ba ltar gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ dad pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ dran pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab khyad par can dbang po'i ngo bo nyid ma yin pa grangs bzhin du/

sangs rgyas dang*/ sbyin pa dang*/ bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ chos thams cad kyi rnam pa thams cad yongs su shes pa la sogs pa'i yul rnam pa lnga la mkhas pa yin no// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka byang sems tshogs lam pa chos can/ khyod mkhas pa'i yul rnam pa lnga la mkhas pa yin no ste/ grangs bzhin du/ sangs rgyas sogs la rab tu dang ba'i dad pa dang*/ sbyin pa sogs la sgrub par spro ba'i brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa sems bskyed sogs la rtag tu mi brjed pa'i dran pa dang*/ bsgom bya sogs rnam par mi rtog par sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ gzugs sogs chos thams cad kyi rang spyi'i rnam pa thams cad yongs su shes pa ste so sor rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab khyad par can la sogs pa rnams la mkhas pas so// tshogs lam du gyur pa'i dad sogs lnga po de chos can/ dbang po'i ngo bo nyid ma yin te/ bden pa'i rnam pa can gyi bsgoms byung ma thob pas so// gnyis pa la/ dngos bstan dang*/ shugs bstan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ de lta mod kyi thams cad kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob pa ma yin te/ 'di ltar dad pa la sogs pa chen po rnon pos ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rtogs par sla la/ de dag nyid rtul pos ni rtogs par dka'o zhes bya ba 'di ni chos nyid yin pas/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka 'dir bstan gyi thar pa cha mthun rang bzhin gyi dbang po rno 'bring rtul gsum ka theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun du gsungs pas/ yul lnga la mkhas pa de lta mod kyi de'i dad sogs thams cad kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob pa sla bar mtshungs pa ma yin te/ rgyu mtshan 'di ltar theg chen tshogs lam pa'i dad pa la sogs pa chen po dbang po rnon pos ni theg pa bar ma chod du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rtogs par sla la dad sogs de dag nyid chung ngu dbang po rtul pos ni bla med byang chub bar ma chod du rtogs par dka'o zhes bya ba 'di ni rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pas so//gnyis pa

( shugs bstan ) ni/ 'grel pa/ shugs kyis ni 'bring po rnams kyis ni rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rtogs la/ chung ngu rnams kyis ni nyan thos kyi byang chub rtogs so zhes bya ba 'di 'phangs pa yin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka gzhung de dag gi shugs kyis na/ rang bzhin gyi dad sogs 'bring po rnams kyis ni rang sangs rgyas kyi lam las de'i byang chub myur bul gang rung du rtogs la rang bzhin gyi dad sogs chung ngu rnams kyis ni nyan thos kyi lam las de'i byang chub myur bul gang rung du rtogs so zhes bya ba 'di 'phangs pa yin no ste/ theg chen gyi dad sogs rnon pos rdzogs pa'i byang chub rtogs par sla la de dag nyid rtul pos ni rtogs par dka'o zhes bya ba 'di dngos su bstan pas so//gnyis pa sbyor ba khyad par can la gsum/ sbyor lam sgom pa'i gnas skabs/ rten phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag /sgom rim khyad par can no/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po ( mtshams sbyar ) ni/ 'grel pa/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa skyes pa'i spro ba can la nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa 'byung bas/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka thar pa cha mthun bshad nas de'i 'og tu nges 'byed cha mthun 'chad de/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa skyes pa'i spro ba can la nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa 'byung bas so//gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir//sems can thams cad yin par bsngags//de dag nyid la sems mnyam sogs//rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do// 35bdag nyid sdig pa las ldog cing*//sbyin la sogs la gnas pas gzhan//de dag la ni 'god pa dang*//bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid// 36rtser gyur de bzhin bzod pa ni//rang gzhan rten can bden shes pa//chos mchog de bzhin sems can rnams//smin byed sogs kyis shes par bya// 37 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka skabs bzhi pa 'dir bstan pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam dro ba chung 'bring chen po rnams chos can/

dmigs rnam khyad par can dang ldan te/ khyod kyi dmiḍa pa'i yul sems can thams cad yin par mdo las bsngags pas de dag nyid la dmigs nas rnam pa dag ni sems mnyam pa dang sogs pas byams pa nas gnyen dang snag gi gnyen mtshams kyi sems kyi rnam pa'i bar bcur bshad do//theg chen sbyor lam rtse mor gyur pa chos can/ bsal ba sngar bzhin/ sems can thams cad la dmigs nas chung ngu'i rnam pa byang sems bdag nyid sdig pa las ldog cing gzhan de dag la 'god pa dang gzhan dag de bzhin du zhugs pa la bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ dga' bas mthun pa nyid kyi rnam pa can dang*/ 'bring gi rnam pa bdag nyid sbyin pa la sogs pa'i dge ba la gnas nas gzhan de dag la ni 'god pa dang gzhan dag de bzhin du zhugs pa la bsngags pa brjod pa dang dga' bas mthun pa nyid kyi rnam pa can dang*/ chen po'i rnam pa rang gnas lugs sgom pa la gnas shing gzhan de la 'god pa dang de la zhugs pa la bsngags pa dang dga' bas mthun pa nyid kyi rnam pa yin pas so//theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzod pa ni chos can/ sngar bzhin/ rtse mo'i skabs su rang gzhan gyi rten can gyi dbye bas sems can la dmigs pa de bzhin du sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa ni chung ngu sdug bsngal sogs bden pa la dmigs pa de shes shing de la gzhan sbyor ba dang zhugs pa la bsngags pa brjod pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ 'bring gi skabs su rang rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu shes pa mngon du bya ba'i phyir sgom zhing gzhan sbyor ba dang gzhan zhugs pa la bsngags pa brjod pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ chen po rang byang sems kyi skyon med pa shes pa la gnas nas gzhan de la 'god pa'i rnam pa can yin pas so//gzhung las/ rang gzhan rten can bden shes pa/ /zhes gsungs pa'i bden shes kyi don ma go ba dag gis log bshad ris mi gcig pa du ma byas mod/ rtse mo dang bzod pa dmigs pa gcig par gsungs pas log bshad rnams 'dor bar byos shig

/theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog chos can/ sngar bzhin/ dmigs pa sems can rnams la dmigs nas chung ngu'i rnam pa ni snga ma bzod rtse de bzhin du rang dge rtsa smin grol sogs byed pa la gnas nas gzhan de la 'god pa dang de la zhugs pa la bsngags pa sogs kyi rnam pa dang*/ 'bring gi rnam pa ni rang mngon shes khyad par can la gnas nas sogs dang*/ chen po'i rnam pa ni rang rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes bskyed pa la gnas nas soḍa kyi phyir/ gsum pa ( 'grel pa ) la/ rtsa ba'i tshig don bshad pa dang*/ zhar las byung ba'i don no/ /dang po la/ bshad/ bsdu gnyis las/ 'grel pa/ rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa 'di la mnyam pa dang*/ byams pa dang*/ phan pa dang*/ khong khro ba med pa dang*/ rnam par 'tshe ba med pa'i sems kyi rnam pa lnga dang*/ pha dang ma'i sems dang*/ spun dang sring mo'i sems dang*/ bu dang bu mo'i sems dang*/ bshes dang grogs kyi sems dang*/ gnyen dang snag gi gnyen 'tshams kyi sems kyi rnam pa gzhan lngas sems can la dmigs pa ni/ dro bar gyur pa yin par bzhed do//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka dang po la bzhi'i dang po drod ni/ rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i gnas skabs 'di la bstan pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam dro bar gyur pa chos can/ dmigs rnam khyad par can dang ldan pa yin par bzhed do ste/ dmigs yul sems can thams cad la dmigs nas ni/ chung ngu'i rnam pa ni nye ring med par mnyam pa dang*/ byams pa'i sems kyi rnam pa can dang*/ 'bring gi rnam pa ni phan pa'i sems dang*/ khong khro ba med pa dang*/ rnam par 'tshe ba med pa'i sems kyi rnam pa can dang*/ chen po'i rnam pa ni rgan pa la pha dang ma'i sems dang*/ mnyam pa la spun dang sring mo'i sems dang*/ gzhon pa la bu dang bu mo'i sems dang*/ phan 'dogs pa'i bshes dang yid brtan pa'i grogs kyi sems dang*/ rus gcig pa'i gnyen dang mi gcig pa'i snag gi gnyen mtshams kyi sems kyi rnam pa ste drod chung 'bring gi rnam pa lnga las gzhan lnga dang ldan pas so//gnyis pa rtse mo ni/

'grel pa/ mdor na mi dge ba dang dge ba la grangs bzhin du spong ba dang len pa'i sgo nas ldog pa dang zhugs pa'i bdag nyid can/ de'i sgo nas gzhan rnams sdig pa las ldog pa dang*/ dge ba la gnas pa dag la sbyor ba'i rnam pa gnyis dang*/ gzhan bdag nyid de bzhin nyid du zhugs pa la bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ mthun par byed pa rnam pa gnyis po chos kyi rab tu dbye bas ni/ rnam pa mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba de rnams kyis sems can la dmigs pa ni/ rtse mor gyur pa yin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka 'dir bstan theg chen gyi sbyor lam rtse mor gyur pa chos can/ dmigs rnam khyad par can dang ldan pa yin no ste/ dmigs yul sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa ni 'jug bya dang ldog bya'i chos kyi gsal ba'i rab tu dbye bas ni rnam pa mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba brjod las 'das pa de rnams kyis dmigs pas na rnam pa mtha' yas kyang mdor bsdus te dge mi dge grangs bzhin du bshad na/ chung ngu'i skabs su mi dge ba la spong ba'i sgo nas ldog pa'i bdag nyid can de'i sgo nas gzhan rnams sdig pa las ldog pa la sbyor ba dang*/ gzhan bdag nyid de bzhin nyid du zhugs pa la bsngags pa brjod pa dang rab tu dga' ba byed pa'i rnam pa can dang*/'bring gi skabs su dge ba la len pa'i sgo nas zhugs pa'i bdag nyid can de'i sgo nas gzhan rnams dge ba la gnas pa dag la sbyor ba sogs snga ma bzhin dang*/ chen po'i skabs su rang stong nyid sgom pa la gnas nas gzhan de la 'god pa sogs kyi rnam pa can yin pas so//bdag la sbyor ba'i rnam pa gnyis dang zhes pa ni rtse mo chung 'bring gnyis la dge mi dge la spong len dang 'jug ldog gi rnam pa gnyis dang zhes pa'i don can yin la mthun par byed pa rnam pa gnyis po zhes pa ni rtse mo de gnyis la bsngags pa brjod tshul gyi rnam pa gnyis yod ces pa'i don can no//gsum pa

( bzod pa ) ni/ 'grel pa/ rtse mor gyur pa la rang dang gzhan gyi rten gyi dbye bas dmigs pa dang rnam pa dag ji lta ba de bzhin du sbyor ba dang*/ bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ mthun pa nyid kyi rnam pa rnams kyis rang dang gzhan gyi rten gyi sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa la dmigs pa ni bzod pa yin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka 'dir bstan theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzod pa chos can/ dmigs rnam khyad par can dang ldan pa yin no ste/ rtse mor gyur pa la rang dang gzhan gyi rten gyi dbye bas sems can la dmigs pa ji lta ba de bzhin du 'dir yang sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa ni/ chung ngu'i skabs su rang gi rten can sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa la dmigs pa ste shes shing gzhan gyi rten can yang sngar gyi rnam pa dag ji lta ba de bzhin du sbyor ba dang bsngags pa brjod pa dang mthun pa nyid kyi rnam pa rnams kyis dang*/ 'bring gi skabs su bdag nyid kyang rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu shes pa sngon du bya ba'i phyir sgom zhing thabs kyi yang dag mtha' mngon du mi byed pa'i thabs mkhas la gnas nas gzhan de la 'god ces sogs dang*/ chen po'i skabs su rang byang sems kyi skyon med pa la gnas nas shes sogs kyi phyir/ bzhi pa

( chos mchog ) ni/ 'grel pa/ snga ma bzhin du rang dang gzhan gyi rten can kho na smin par byed pa dang*/ grol bar byed pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa dag gis sems can la dmigs pa ni chos kyi mchog yin te/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka 'dir bstan theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos kyi mchog chos can/ dmigs rnam khyad par can dang ldan pa yin te/ sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa ni chung ngu'i skabs su snga ma rtse mo dang*/ bzod pa bzhin du rang gi rten can dge rtsa smin par byed pa dang grol bar byed pa la dmigs nas gzhan gyi rten can kho na smin grol byed pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa dag gis dang*/ 'bring gi skabs su rang mngon shes khyad par can la gnas nas shes sogs dang*/ chen po'i skabs su rang rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes bskyed pa la gnas nas shes sogs kyi phyir/ gnyis pa bsdu ba ni/ 'grel pa/ de ltar na nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa yin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa bzhi chos can/ dmigs rnam khyad par can dang ldan pa yin no ste/ bshad pa de ltar na'i phyir/ gnyis pa zhar las byung ba'i don la gnyis/ skabs dang po gsum du lam gsum bstan pa'i 'dod tshul dang*/ sbyor ba dang gsum du de bstan pa'i 'dod tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ rnam pa dang lam dang gzhi thams cad rnam par bsgom pa'i dbye bas go rim bzhin du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la sogs pa mngon par rtogs pa rnam pa gsum la 'jig rten pa'i nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa rtogs pa sngon du 'gro bas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mthong ba dang*/ sgom pa'i lam rtogs pa yin la/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa la sogs pa gsum la ni sgom pa gong nas gong gi gnas skabs kyi khyad par gyis/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka kha cig na re/ skabs dang po gsum du sbyor mthong sgom gsum lan gsum du bstan pa la dgos pa ci yod ce na/

rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang la sogs pas lam shes dang gzhi shes te mngon par rtogs pa rnam pa gsum la sbyor mthong sgom gsum lan gsum bstan pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ go rim bzhin du gzhi lam rnam gsum bden med du don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa rtogs pa sngon du 'gro bas de mngon sum du rtogs pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam rtogs pa'i ched yin pas so//de ltar na zlos pa'i skyon yod do zhe na/ de'i skyon med de/ skabs dang por rnam pa dang gnyis par lam dang gsum par gzhi thams cad skye med du rtogs nas rnam par bsgoms pa'i khyad par gyi dbye ba yod pas so//skabs gsum par nges cha dang sgom lam gyi tha snyad tshig zin la gsungs pa med kyang dang po gnyis su gsum ka bstan pa'i mdo'i dbang gis sam gzhi shes sbyor ba'i skabs su de gnyis don gyis bstan pas skyon med do//gnyis pa ( sbyor ba dang gsum du de bstan pa'i 'dod tshul ) ni/ 'grel pa/ rnam pa thams cad du khyad par gyi lam gyis bsdus pa'i ye shes zag pa med pa chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po rim gyis skye ba yin pas/ cig car skye ba dgag par bya ba'i phyir nges par byed pa'i cha la sogs pa'i tha snyad du gsungs pa yin par shes par bya'o// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka bdag gi bla ma rnams gzhung rjes ma 'di mkhan po rnam snang mdzad kyi lugs bkod par bzhed pas/ de dang mthun par 'chad na/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba la sogs pa sbyor ba dang po gsum las rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i skabs su sa brgyad pa'i ye shes zag pa med pa chung ngu dang*/ 'bring dang*/ chen po gsum la nges par 'byed pa'i cha la sogs pa'i tha snyad du gsungs pa yin par shes par bya'o//rtse sbyor gyi skabs su sa dgu pa'i ye shes chung 'bring che gsum dang mthar gyis pa'i skabs su sa bcu pa'i ye shes chung 'bring che gsum la rim bzhin nges cha sogs kyi tha snyad du gsungs pa yin par shes par bya'o ste/

lam gsum dang ye shes gsum po de rim gyis skye bar mthun pa'i phyir te/ sgom pa gong nas gong du phul du byung bar 'gro ba'i gnas skabs kyi khyad par gyis bsdus pas so/ /zag med kyi ye shes de gsum la lam gsum por btags pa la dgos pa yod de/ dag sar mi rtog ye shes la dbang thob pas cig car skye'am snyam pa'i dogs pa dgag par bya ba'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ dngos la gnod byed ni/ de nges cha sogs dngos min te rnam pa thams cad du+u sa bdun pa man las khyad par du+u 'phags pa'i lam gyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ lung rigs 'brug sgrar gzhung phyi ma 'di yang rang gzhung du mdzad pas de'i bzhed pa ltar na/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa la sogs pa gsum la ni nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa la sogs pa'i tha snyad du gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ rnam pa thams cad du nyan rang las khyad par gyi lam gyis bsdus pa'i ye shes 'dzin stangs la zag pa med pa chung ngu rnam rdzogs sbyor ba 'bring rtse sbyor chen po mthar gyis pa rnams rim gyis skye ba yin pas cig car skye ba dgag par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ sbyor ba gsum po rim gyis skye ba yin te/ sbyor mthong sgom gsum gyi gnas skabs su sgom pa gong nas gong gi gnas skabs kyi khyad par du byas pa'i phyir ro//gnyis pa rten phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag la bzhi/ mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun la ji skad bshad pa'i nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa 'byung bas phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyi mtshan nyid/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka des cha'i 'og tu rten phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun gyi mtshan nyid 'chad de/ ji skad bshad pa'i nges cha thob pa las phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun 'byung bas so//gnyis pa

( bstan ) la/ rtsa ba/ 'grel pa gnyis las/ dang po ( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ nges 'byed yan lag nas bzung ste//mthong dang sgom pa'i lam dag la//byang chub sems dpa' gang dag gnas//de 'dir mi ldog pa yi tshogs// 38rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa dbang rnon nas bzung ste de'i mthong lam pa dbang 'bring dang*/ gnas lugs mthong zin goms pa'i lam la gnas pa theg chen sgom lam pa dbang rtul dag ste byang chub sems dpa' de gsum chos can/ skabs 'dir slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs yin te/ rang rgyud kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags gang dang gang dag rtogs pa'i tshul gyis de dang de la gnas pa'i sems dpa' yin pas so//ngag don/ byang sems sbyor lam pa dbang rnon dang mthong lam pa dbang 'bring dang sgom lam pa dbang rtul rnams chos can/ bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog ste/ bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ( 'grel pa ) ni/ 'grel pa/ dpa' bo gang dag nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa bzhi dang*/ mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam 'chad par 'gyur ba la/ de dang de rtogs pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa de dag ni/ byang chub sems dpa' slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun yin no/ /bam po bzhi pa// 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka 'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo sems dpa' gang dag nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa bzhi dang theg chen gyi mthong ba'i lam dang de'i sgom pa'i lam 'chad par 'gyur ba la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag ni chos can/ slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun yin no ste/ mi ldog pa'i rtags nyi shu dang bcu drug dang brgyad po de dang de rtogs pa'i tshul gyis gnas pas so/ /bam po bzhi pa 'di nas 'chad do//gsum pa rgyas bshad la gsum/ sbyor lam pa/ mthong lam pa/ sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags so/

/dang po la/ bstan/ bshad gnyis las/ dang po la gsum gyi/ dang po ( mtshams sbyar ) ni/ 'grel pa/ de rnams kyi mtshan nyid ma 'dres pa gang yin zhe na/ re shig bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa la gnas pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka sbyor mthong sgom gsum gyi rtags gsum yod pa las re zhig bar tshigs gcig gis nges cha la gnas pa rnams kyi rtags kyi mtshan nyid mdor bstan pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ gsum po de rnams kyi mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid so sor ma 'dres pa gang yin zhe na de'i lan bstan pa'i ched yod pas so//gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ gzugs la sogs las ldog sogs rtags//rnam pa nyi shur brjod pa yis//nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa'i//phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid 'di// 39rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa'i byang sems phyir mi ldog par mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid 'di chos can/ nyi shu yod de/ gzugs la sogs pa'i chos las bden zhen mngon gyur ba ldog pa la soḍa pa'i rtaḍa rnam pa nyi shur brjod pa yin pas so//gsum pa ( 'grel pa ) ni/'grel pa/ gzugs la sogs pa las ldog pa dang*/ the tshom med pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa/ rnam pa nyi shur nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa la gnas pa rnams kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid shes par bya ba yin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa la gnas pa'i byang sems rnams kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid du shes par bya ba chos can/ rnam pa nyi shu yin no ste/ gzugs la sogs pa las ldog pa dang*/ the tshom med pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa nyi shu yod pas so// gnyis pa ( bshad ) la gsum las/ dang po ( mtshams sbyar ) ni/ 'grel pa/ yang ldog pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid de dag gang yin zhe na/ de dag bstan pa'i phyir bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa drug po//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka

yang*/ gzugs la sogs las ldog pa dang*/ /zhes sogs bar tshigs drug po gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ ldog pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid de dag gang yin zhe na/ de dag bstan pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) la/ drod/ rtse/ bzod/ mchog bzhi las/ dang po drod kyi rtags bcu gcig ni/ rtsa ba/ gzugs la sogs las ldog pa dang*//the tshom mi dal zad pa dang*//bdag nyid dge ba la gnas shing*//gzhan dag de la 'god pa dang*// 40gzhan gyi rten can sbyin sogs dang*//zab mo'i don la'ang som nyi med//byams lus sogs dang sgrib pa ni//rnam pa lnga dang mi 'grogs dang*// 41 bag la nyal kun 'joms pa dang*//dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dang*//gos la sogs pa gtsang ba dang*//rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka sbyor lam drod la gnas pa'i byang sems dbang rnon gyi rgyud kyi gzugs la sogs pa'i chos las bden zhen mngon gyur ba ldog pa'i rtags dang*/ the tshom zad pa dang*/ mi dal ba ste mi khom pa brgyad zad pa dang*/ bdag nyid dge ba la gnas shing gzhan dag dge ba de la 'god pa dang*/ sems can gzhan gyi rten can te gzhan don du sbyin sogs kyi dge sngo ba dang*/ gnas lugs zab mo'i don la'ang som nyi med pa dang*/ byams pas zin pa'i lus dang sogs pas ngag yid gsum gyi las gzhan la phan pa nyid dang*/ sgrib pa ni rnam pa lnga po 'dod 'dun gnod sems gnyid rmugs rgod 'gyod dang mi 'grogs pa dang*/ ma rig pa dang lta ba'i bag la nyal kun 'joms pa dang*/ rtag tu dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dang ldan pa dang*/ chos gos gnas mal la sogs pa gtsang ba dang bcu gcig go/rtse mo'i rtags drug ni/ rtsa ba/ lus la srin bu rnams mi 'byung*// 42gya gyu med sems sbyangs pa ni//len dang ser sna med sogs dang*//chos nyid ldan par 'gro nyid dang*//sems can don du dmyal tshol dang*// 43 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka lus la srin bu'i ris brgyad khri rnams mi 'byung ba lus rnam dag dang*/

dman pa yid byed sogs gya gyu'i sems med pa sems rnam dag dang*/ phyag dar khrod pa sogs sbyangs pa'i yon tan ni bcu gnyis len pa spyod pa rnam dag dang*/ sbyin sogs dang 'gal ba ser sna dang 'chal tshul sogs med pa sgrub pa rnam dag dang*/ chos nyid dang mi 'gal bar sher phyin dang ldan par byang chub tu 'gro ba nyid de rnal 'byor rnam dag dang*/ sems can gzhan gyi don du dmyal ba yang 'dod cing 'tshol ba bsam pa rnam dag rnams so//bzod pa'i rtags gnyis ni/ rtsa ba/ gzhan gyis bkri bar mi btub dang*//lam gzhan nye bar ston bdud la//bdud ces bya bar rtogs pa dang*//rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka bdud sogs gzhan gyis lam gzhan la bkri bar mi btub pa rang gi lam mi 'dor ba dang*/ phyin drug dang 'gal ba'i lam gzhan bcos ma'i lam nye bar ston pa'i bdud la bdud ces bya bar rtogs pa gzhan gyi lam la mi 'jug pa dang gnyis so//chos mchog gi rtags gcig ni/ rtsa ba/ sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i spyod pa ste// 44 rtags ni nyi shu de dag gis//drod dang rtse mo bzod bcas dang*//chos mchog rnams la gnas pa ni//rdzogs pa'i byang chub las mi ldog/ 45 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka spyod pa thams cad la sangs rgyas dgyes pa thob pa'o/ /de ltar na byang sems sbyor lam pa dbang rnon phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags ni nyi shu po de dag gis sbyor lam drod dang rtse mo dang bzod par bcas pa dang chos kyi mchog rnams la gnas pa'i byang sems dbang rnon ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par mtshon no//gsum pa ( 'grel pa ) ni/ sbyor lam dro ba dang rtse mo dang bzod pa dang chos kyi mchog rnams la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dbang rnon chos can/ khyod bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa yin par mtshon byed yod de/ drod sogs bzhi dang mi ldog pa'i rtags rnams go rim bzhin du sbyar na drod kyi rtags bcu gcig rtse mo'i drug bzod pa'i gnyis chos mchog gi gcig ste nyi shu po 'di dag gis mtshon te khyod byang chub las mi ldog par shes par bya ba yin pas so//de yang zhib tu bshad na drod sogs bzhi las/

dang po drod kyi rtags bcu gcig ni/ 'grel pa/ ngo bo nyid med pa nyid kyis gzugs la sogs pa'i chos las ldog pa dang*/ shes nas dad pa thob pas the tshom zad pa dang*/ smon lam grub pas log par lta ba dang*/ dmyal ba dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ dud 'gror skye ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' mi thos pa dang*/ yul mtha' 'khob tu skye ba dang*/ dbang po ma tshang ba dang*/ glen pa dang*/ lkugs pa'i dngos po dang*/ lha tshe ring por skye ba zhes bya ba mi khom pa brgyad zad pa dang*/ snying rjes bdag dang gzhan dge ba'i chos la sbyor ba dang*/ bdag dang gzhan du brje ba nyid kyis sems can gzhan gyi yul la yongs su bsngos pa'i sbyin pa la sogs pa dang*/ chos yang dag par rtogs pas zab mo'i don la yang som nyi mi byed pa dang*/ gzhan la phan pa nyid du zhugs pas byams pa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las dang*/ sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pas sgrib pa lnga po 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang*/ gnod sems dang*/ gnyid dang rmugs pa dang*/ rgod pa dang 'gyod pa dang*/ the tshom dag dang mi 'grogs pa dang*/ gnyen po rnam par bsgoms pa nyid kyis ma rig pa la sogs pa'i bag la nyal ba thams cad 'joms pa dang*/ rtag tu mnyam par gzhag pa nyid kyis dran pa dang shes bzhin dang ldan pa dang*/ gtsang sbra kun du spyod pa nyid kyis gos la sogs pa yongs su spyod pa gtsang ba zhes bya ba rnam pa bcu gcig dang*/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka sbyor lam drod la gnas pa'i byang sems dbang rnon chos can/ gzugs la sogs pa'i chos las bden zhen mngon gyur ba ldog pa yin te/ gzugs sogs bden pa'i ngo bo nyid med par rtogs pa nyid kyis so/ /de chos can/ dkon mchog gi yon tan la the tshom zad pa yin te/ de'i yon tan shes nas dad pa thob pas so/ /chos can/ mi khom pa brgyad du skye ba'i rgyu zad pa yin te/ las 'bras med 'dzin gyi log par lta ba can dang*/ dmyal ba dang*/

yi dwags dang*/ dud 'gror skye ba dang*/ rdzogs byed dus kyi sems can lta bu sangs rgyas kyi bka' mi thos pa dang*/ 'khor rnam bzhi mi rgyu ba'i yul mtha' 'khob tu skye ba dang*/ spyir dbang po ma tshang ba dang bye brag tu yid dbang skyon can glen pa dang lce dbang skyon can lkugs pa'i dngos po dang*/ 'du shes med pa'i lha tshe ring por skye ba zhes bya ba brgyad po der mi skye ba'i smon lam grub pas so//'dir dbang po ma tshang ba dang glen lkugs gsum gcig tu bgrangs la mdo dran nyer kla klo gcig tu bgrangs nas mtha' 'khob tu skyes pa dbang po ma tshang ba glen pa rnams ma bgrangs gzhan yang brgyad po 'di'i 'dren tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' snang ngo*//chos can/ bdag dge ba la gnas pa dang gzhan dge ba'i chos la sbyor bar byed de/ gzhan la snying rje chen po dang ldan pas so/ /chos can/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i dge ba dmigs yul sems can gzhan gyi yul la yongs su bsngos pa yin te/ bdag gi bde ba dang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal brje ba nyid kyis so/ /chos can/ zab mo'i don la'ang som nyi mi byed de/ chos zab mo yang dag par rtogs pas so/ /chos can/ byams pas zin pa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las dang ldan te/ bsam sbyor gnyis kyis gzhan la phan pa nyid du zhugs pas so/ /chos can/ sgrib pa lnga po tshul khrims kyi bar gcod 'dod pa'i yon tan la sred pa'i 'dun pa dang*/ mnar sems pa'i gnod sems dang*/ nang du zhum pa gnyid dang*/ sems mi gsal ba rmugs pa dang*/ sems phyir 'phro ba'i rgod pa dang ngan byas la yid gcags pa'i 'gyod pa dang*/ btang snyoms kyi bar gcod the tshom dag dang mi 'grogs te/ bslab pa gsum gyi sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa thob pas so//'dir gnyid rmugs gnyis dang rgod 'gyod gnyis sgrib pa re rer bzhag pa ni rgyu byed las gnyen po rnams gcig pas der bzhag pa ste/

so sor bgrangs na bdun du 'gyur bas so//chos can/ ma rig pa dang lta ba la sogs pa'i bag la nyal thams cad 'joms pa ste/ gnyen po stong pa nyid rnam par bsgoms pa nyid kyis so/ /chos can/ spyod lam kun tu dran pa dang shes bzhin dang ldan pa ste/ rtag tu ma yengs par blang dor gyi gnas la mnyam par gzhag pa nyid kyis so/ /chos can/ chos gos dang mal cha la sogs pa yongs su spyod pa la gzhan gyis smad du med pas gtsang ba zhes bya ste/ phyi nang gi gtsang sbra kun tu spyod pa nyid kyis so/ /de ltar drod kyi rtags rnam pa bcu gcig dang*/ gnyis pa rtse mo'i rtags drug ni/ 'grel pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'jig rten las mngon par 'phags pa nyid kyis lus la srin bu'i rigs brgyad khri mi 'byung ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par dag pas sems gya gyu med pa dang*/ rnyed pa dang bkur bsti la sogs pa la mi lta ba nyid kyis phyag dar khrod pa nyid la sogs pa sbyangs pa'i yon tan yang dag par len pa dang*/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i khyad par sgrub pas de dag dang 'gal ba ser sna dang 'chal ba'i tshul khrims la sogs pa med pa dang*/ chos thams cad yang dag par bsdus pa nyid kyis chos nyid dang mi 'gal bar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan par 'gro ba dang*/ 'gro ba bdag nyid kyi byas pa nyid kyis gzhan gyi don du dmyal ba 'dod pa zhes bya ba rnam pa drug dang*/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka sbyor lam rtse mo la gnas pa'i byang sems dbang rnon chos can/ lus la srin bu'i ris brgyad khri mi 'byung ba ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'jig rten tha mal ba las mngon par 'phags pa thob pa nyid kyis so/ /chos can/ nyan rang gis yid la byed pa sogs gya gyu'i sems med pa ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba theg chen gyi sems rnam par dag pa thob pas so/ /chos can/ phyag dar khrod pa dang bsod snyoms pa nyid la sogs pa sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis yang dag par len pa ste/

rnyed pa dang bkur sti la sogs pa la mi lta ba'i sems thob pa nyid kyis so/ /chos can/ sbyin sogs de dag dang 'gal ba ser sna dang 'chal pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa med pa ste/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i khyad par mchog tu sgrub pas so/ /chos can/ chos nyid dang mi 'gal bar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan par byang chub tu 'gro ba ste/ gzugs sogs chos thams cad stong pa nyid du yang dag par sdud pa nyid kyis so/ /chos can/ gzhan gyi don du dmyal ba yang 'dod pa zhes bya ba ste/ snying rjes 'gro ba thams cad bu bzhin du bdag nyid kyis byas pa nyid kyis so/ /de ltar rtse mo'i rtags rnam pa drug dang*/gsum pa bzod pa'i rtags gnyis ni/ 'grel pa/ rtogs pa la yid ches pa'i chos nyid kyis gzhan gyis bkri bar mi btub pa dang*/

sangs rgyas nyid kyi thabs shes pa la mkhas pa nyid kyis lam ltar bcos pa nye bar ston pa'i bdud la bdud nyid du rtogs pa zhes bya ba rnam pa gnyis dang*/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka sbyor lam bzod pa la gnas pa'i byang sems dbang rnon chos can/ bdud la sogs pa gzhan gyis lam gzhan la bkrir mi btub pa ste/ gnas lugs rtogs pa la yid ches brtan po thob pa'i chos nyid kyis so/ /chos can/ phyin drug dang 'gal ba lam ltar bcos ma nye bar ston pa'i bdud la bdud nyid du rtogs pa zhes bya ba yin te/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi thabs phyin drug shes pa la mkhas pa nyid kyis so/ /de ltar bzod pa'i rtags rnam pa gnyis dang*/ bzhi pa chos mchog gi rtags gcig ni/ 'grel pa/ 'khor gsum rnam par dag pas spyod pa thams cad la sangs rgyas dgyes pa zhes bya ba rnam pa gcig gis go rim bzhin du dro ba dang*/ rtse mo dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ chos kyi mchog rnams la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa yin par rtags nyi shu po 'di dag gis shes par bya'o//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka sbyor lam chos mchog la gnas pa'i byang sems dbang rnon chos can/ spyod pa thams cad la sangs rgyas dgyes pa zhes bya ba'i rtags thob ste/ shes rab kyi stobs kyis 'khor gsum la mtshan 'dzin rnam par dag pa thob pas so/ /de ni chos mchog gi rtags rnam pa gcig go/gnyis pa mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags la/ bstan/ bshad gnyis las/ dang po la gsum las/ dang po ( mtshams sbyar ) ni/ 'grel pa/ nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid kyi 'og tu/ mthong ba'i lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis gsungs pa/'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa bzhi'i phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid bshad pa'i 'og tu theg chen gyi mthong ba'i lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid bar tshigs gcig gis mdor bstan gsungs te/

de skabs su bab pas so//gnyis pa ( rtsa ba ) ni/ rtsa ba/ mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa dang*//shes pa'i skad cig bcu drug ni//byang chub sems dpa' mi ldog pa'i//mtshan nyid yin par shes par bya// 46 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka bden bzhi la dmigs pa'i chos bzod bzhi dang*/ rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa bzhi dang*/ chos shes bzhi dang*/ rjes su shes pa bzhi ste/ mthong lam shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug gi ming can gyi rtags bcu drug ni chos can/byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba'i lam la gnas pa phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid dag yin par shes par bya ste/ de phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun du mtshon par byed pa'i rtags yin pas so//gsum pa ( 'grel pa ) ni/ 'grel pa/ sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa'i sgo nas/ chos dang rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ shes pa'i skad cig ma bcu drug ni/ byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba'i lam la gnas pa rnams kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid yin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa bzhi'i sgo nas chos bzod bzhi dang rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa bzhi dang shes pa brgyad de skad cig ma bcu drug gi ming can rnams ni chos can/ byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba'i lam la gnas pa rnams kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid dag yin no ste/ de phyir mi ldog par mtshon par byed pa'i rtags yin pas so//gnyis pa rgyas bshad la gsum las/ dang po ( mtshams sbyar ) ni/ 'grel pa/ skad cig ma'i rnam pa ci 'dra ba zhig mtshan nyid yin zhe na/ rnam pa rnams bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa lngas gsungs pa ni/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bcu drug gi rnam pa rnams bar tshigs lngas gsungs pa ni chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ bzod shes skad cig ma bcu drug gi rnam pa ci 'dra ba zhig phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid yin zhe na/ de'i lan bstan pa'i ched yod pas so//gnyis pa

( rtsa ba ) la/ dbye/ bsdu gnyis las/ dang po ( dbye ba ) la bzhi las/ dang po ( sdug bden gyi rnam pa ) ni/ rtsa ba/ gzugs sogs 'du shes ldog pa dang*//sems brtan theg pa dman dag las//rnam log bsam gtan la soḍa pa'i//yan lag yongs su zad pa dang*// 47 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka gzugs sogs la bden zhen gyi 'du shes ldog pa dang*/ byang sems brtan pa dang*/ theg pa dman pa dag las sems rnam par log pa dang*/ bsam gtan gzugs med la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug kyang de'i dbang gis khams gong du skye ba'i yan lag yongs su zad pa dang bzhi ni sdug bden gyi rnam pa yin no//gnyis pa ( kun bden gyi rnam pa ) ni/ rtsa ba/ lus sems yang ba nyid dang ni//'dod la spyod la thabs mkhas dang*//rtag tu tshangs par spyod nyid dang*//'tsho ba rnam par dag nyid dang*// 48 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka lus dang sems yang ba nyid thob pa dang ni/ mngon zhen med par 'dod pa la nye bar spyod pa la thabs mkhas pa'i mthu thob pa dang*/ rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa la 'jug pa nyid dang*/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnam par dag pa nyid dang bzhi ni kun bden gyi rnam pa yin no//gsum pa ( 'gog pa'i rnam pa ) ni/ rtsa ba/ phung sogs bar chad byed rnams dang*//tshogs dang dbang sogs bcas pa yi//g.yul 'gyed rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka shes bya phung sogs la sbyor dang rjes su sbyor ba'i gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang*/ mi mthun phyogs bar chad byed rnams la sbyor dang rjes su dang*/ gnyen po sbyin sogs byang chub kyi rgyu tshogs la sbyor dang rjes su dang*/ ming la zhen pa 'gog pa dbang sogs bcas pa yi g.yul 'gyed la sogs la sbyor dang rjes su sbyor ba yi gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang bzhi ni 'gog pa'i rnam pa yin no//bzhi pa ( lam bden gyi rnam pa ) ni/ rtsa ba/ ser sna la sogs la//sbyor dang rjes su sbyor ba yi//

49gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang*//chos ni rdul tsam mi dmigs nyid//rang gi sa la nges pa nyid//sa gsum la ni gnas pa dang*// 50 chos kyi don du srog gtong ba//rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka ser sna la sogs la sbyor dang rjes su sbyor ba yi gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang*/ rtogs pa'i chos ni rdul tsam yang mi dmigs pa nyid dang*/ rang gis thob pa'i sa gsum la ni nges pa nyid du gnas pa dang*/ chos kyi don du srog gtong bar nus pa dang bzhi ni lam bden gyi rnam pa yin no//gnyis pa bsdu ba ni/ rtsa ba/ de 'dra'i skad cig bcu drug ni//blo ldan mthong ba'i lam gnas pa'i//phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dag yin// 51 rtsa ba'i sbyor ṭīka bshad pa de 'dra ba'i skad cig ma bcu drug gi ming can ni blo ldan byang sems mthong ba'i lam la gnas pa rnams kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dag yin no//dbang sogs bcas pa yi sogs la ngag don/ 'gog pa rjes shes la gnas pa'i byang sems dbang 'bring chos can/ dbang sogs la bden par zhen pa'i gnas pa bkag ste/ gzung 'dzin bden med du rtoḍa nas gzung 'dzin du mngon par zhen pa spangs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'grel pa la/ rtags kyi dbye ba dang*/ rtags su gzung bya gnyis las/ dang po la bzhi las/ sdug bden gyi rnam pa ni/ 'grel pa/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyis gzugs la sogs pa'i chos su rtogs pa las ldog pa dang*/ sangs rgyas la sogs pas byin gyis brlabs pas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems brtan pa nyid dang*/ theg pa chen po'i chos khyad par can bsgrubs pas/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa las sems rnam par log pa dang*/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i mthus bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la sogs par skye ba'i yan lag yang dag par yongs su zad pa zhes bya ba bzhi ni sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa yin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka

theg chen mthong lam pa dbang 'bring chos can/ gzugs la sogs pa'i chos su bden par rtog pa las ldog pa'i rtags thob ste/ gzugs sogs rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa nyid du rtogs pa nyid kyis so/ /chos can/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems brtan pa nyid kyi rtags thob ste/ sangs rgyas dang la sogs pas byang sems gong ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pas so/ /chos can/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa las sems rnam par log pa'i rtags thob ste/ theg pa chen po'i chos khyad par can thabs shes zung 'brel du bsgrubs pas so/ /chos can/ mthong chos bder gnas kyi don du bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dag pa ba la sogs pa la 'jug kyang de'i dbang gis khams gong du skye ba'i yan lag yang dag par yongs su zad pa'i rtags thob ste/ chos rnams stong pa nyid du rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i mthu thob pas so/ /zhes bya ba bzhi ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'i rnam pa yin no//gnyis pa kun bden gyi rnam pa ni/ 'grel pa/ mi dge ba dang bral ba nyid kyis lus dang sems yang ba dang*/ sems can gdul ba'i thabs la mkhas pa'i mthus mngon par zhen pa med par 'dod pa la nye bar spyod pa dang*/ yul gyi nyes dmigs mthong bas rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa nyid dang*/ skyes bu dam pa'i chos nyid kyis 'tsho ba'i yo byad yang dag par rnam par dag pa nyid ces bya ba bzhi ni kun 'byung ba'i rnam pa yin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka chos can/ ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin lus sems dge ba la bskul du rung bar lus dang sems yang ba thob ste/ mthong spang du gyur pa'i mi dge ba dang bral ba nyid kyis so/ /chos can/ 'dod pa'i yon tan la mngon par zhen pa med par nye bar spyod pa thob ste/ chags can gyi sems can 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas pa'i mthu thob pas so/ /chos can/ rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa la 'jug pa nyid thob ste/

yul gyi nyes dmigs 'di phyi'i sdug bsngal bskyed pa sogs mthong bas so/ /chos can/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnams yang dag par rnam par dag pa nyid thob ste/ byang sems mi brjed pa la dbang ba'i skyes bu dam pa'i chos can yin pa nyid kyis so/ /zhes bya ba bzhi ni kun 'byung ba'i bden pa'i rnam pa yin no//gsum pa 'gog bden gyi rnam pa ni/ 'grel pa/ stong pa nyid la gnas pa nyid kyis phung po dang skye mched dang khams rnams la sbyor ba dang rjes su sbyor ba dag tu mi bya'o/ /zhes de ltar sbyor ba dang*/ rjes su sbyor ba'i gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs bsal ba nyid kyis rtogs pa'i bar chad byed pa'i tshogs rnams la snga ma bzhin du sbyor ba dang*/ rjes su sbyor ba'i gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang*/ rnam par rtog pa'i skyon yongs su shes pa nyid kyis byang chub kyi tshogs sbyin pa la sogs la snga ma bzhin du sbyor ba dang rjes su sbyor ba'i gtam la gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang*/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa dag spang bar bya ba nyid kyis dbang po dang rten grong khyer la sogs pa'i g.yul 'gyed pa la snga ma bzhin du sbyor ba dang rjes su sbyor ba'i gnas pa rjes su bkag pa zhes bya ba bzhi ni 'gog pa'i rnam pa yin no//'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka chos can/ phung po dang skye mched dang khams rnams la mdo las sbyor ba dang rjes su sbyor ba dag tu mi bya'o zhes gsungs pa de ltar du dang por zhen pas sbyor ba dang rgyun du zhen pas rjes su sbyor ba'i mngon zhen gyis gnas pa so sor bkag pa ste/ phung sogs stong pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa la gnas pa nyid kyis so/ /chos can/ mthong lam gyi rtogs pa'i bar chad byed pa'i chos rnams la snga ma bzhin du sbyor ba dang rjes su sbyor ba'i tshul du gnas pa so sor bkag pa ste/ mthong lam gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs bsal bar byas pa nyid kyis so/

/chos can/ mdo las dmag gi sgras gsungs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu tshogs sbyin pa la sogs pa la snga ma bzhin du sbyor ba dang rjes su sbyor ba'i gtam la gnas pa so sor bkag ste/ rnam par rtog pa'i skyon yongs su shes pa nyid kyis so/ /chos can/ mdo las grong gi sgras dbang po dang grong khyer gyi sgras dbang rten dang la sogs pa grong rdal gyi sgras dbang yul dang bdag dang spang gnyen g.yul 'gyed pa'i gtam la snga ma bzhin du sbyor ba dang rjes su sbyor ba'i gnas pa rjes su bkag ste/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa dag spang bar bya ba nyid kyis so/ /zhes bya ba bzhi po 'di ni 'gog pa'i bden pa'i rnam pa yin no//de la grong ni so nam pa'i khyim gcig gnyis sogs yod pa'i gnas te/ des so nam pa'i rten byed pa ltar dbang pos dbang shes kyi rten byed/ grong khyer ni bzo rig pa mi 'dra ba bco brgyad yod pa'i gnas te/ de skye bo mang po 'du ba'i gzhi yin pa ltar dbang rten 'byung ba bzhi 'byung 'gyur gzugs dri ro reg bya ste rdul rdzas brgyad dbang po'i gzhi dang*/ grong rdal ni tshong dus kyi gnas te/ de skye bos longs spyod pa'i yul yin pa ltar gzugs sgra sogs dbang shes kyi yul yin no//bzhi pa lam bden gyi rnam pa ni/ 'grel pa/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i khyad par rtogs pas ser sna dang 'chal ba'i tshul khrims la sogs pa la sbyor ba dang rjes su sbyor ba'i gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang*/ chos thams cad rnam bar thar pa'i sgo gsum gyi ngo bo nyid yin pas rtogs pa'i chos rdul tsam yang mi dmigs pa dang*/ mngon par yid ches pa thob pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid kyi rang gis gsum la ji lta ba bzhin du nges pa nyid kyis gnas pa dang*/ gcig tu gzhol ba nyid kyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la sogs pa'i chos kyi don du srog gtong ba zhes bya ba bzhi ni lam gyi rnam pa yin te/

'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka chos can/ ser sna dang 'chal pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa la sbyor ba dang rjes su sbyor ba'i gnas pa so sor bkag pa ste/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin khyad par can rtogs pas so/ /chos can/ byang phyogs sogs rtogs pa'i chos bden par rdul tsam yang mi dmigs te/ chos thams cad rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyi ngo bo nyid du mnyam pa nyid yin pas so/ /chos can/ rang gis thob pa'i sa gsum la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid la ji lta ba bzhin du nges pa nyid kyis gnas pa yin te/ rang gi rtogs pa la gzhan gyis mi 'phrog par mngon par yid ches pa thob pas so/ /chos can/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la sogs pa rnam mkhyen gyi rgyur gyur pa'i chos kyi don du srog kyang gtong bar nus te/ mtha' gcig tu rnam mkhyen gyi ched du gzhol pa nyid kyis so/ /zhes bya ba bzhi ni lam gyi bden pa'i rnam pa yin no//gnyis pa rtags su gzung bya ni/ 'grel pa/ de ltar na bzod pa dang*/ shes pa'i skad cig ma rnam pa bcu drug gis bsdus pa 'di rnams yang dag par thob pa na/ dag pa 'jig rten pa gzung ba dang 'dzin par mngon par ma zhen pa'i rnam pa can rjes kyi sems kyis bsdus pas rang dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu gzugs la sogs pa'i 'du shes bzlog pa la sogs pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba'i lam la gnas pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid dag yin no/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi tha snyad ni sems can gdul ba'i dgos pa'i dbang ma gtogs par thams cad du rtogs pa dang mthun pa kho na yin no/ /zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir nye bar btags nas bshad de/ de ltar ma yin na rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud la so so rang gis rig pa'i skad cig ma rnams ji ltar gzhan yid ches par byed pa'i mtshan nyid dag yin/ 'grel pa'i sbyor ṭīka
